text: dsh-model-sync 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的模型目录同步插件。它接入 DSH 的 LLM、Web 服务、凭据和设置模块，按计划或手动触发服务商模型目录同步，并在管理面板中查看和调整配置。它支持多个云端及本地模型服务商，规范化模型能力与目录信息，支持模型筛选、别名和变更历史。适合需要集中维护多个模型来源的 DSH 管理者；可通过配置控制同步周期、策略和通知。

dsh-model-sync keeps DSH model catalogs synchronized. It connects to DSH language model, web, credential, and settings services, supports scheduled or manual provider sync, and offers a web panel for configuration. It normalizes model data and provides filtering, aliases, and change history.

dsh-model-sync 的功能「模型目录同步」：插件协调服务商适配器获取模型清单并同步到 DSH 目录；可由调度器周期执行，也可通过管理功能触发。
dsh-model-sync 的功能「多服务商模型发现」：适配器注册中心定义多个服务商的模型列表端点，并由同步器统一获取与处理目录。
dsh-model-sync 的功能「模型同步管理面板」：Web 面板提供模型同步相关设置入口，用于查看和调整插件配置。
dsh-model-sync 的功能「本地 Ollama 模型管理」：插件提供 Ollama 服务相关管理模块和路由，支持连接本地 Ollama 服务处理模型目录。
dsh-model-sync 的功能「同步状态与历史」：同步器配合状态存储记录运行状态，并支持管理接口访问目录及配置数据。

@goodandready/dsh-model-sync README · ⚡ Overview：**`dsh-model-sync`** keeps your **DeepSeek Harness** model catalog up-to-date with upstream AI providers.

Instead of manually editing YAML configs whenever a provider launches a new model, adjusts context window limits, or changes pricing, `dsh-model-sync` automatically discovers new releases, updates capability metadata (`vision`, `tools`, `reasoning`, `embeddings`), tracks account balances, manages model selection visibility, and reconciles models on the fly without server restarts.

@goodandready/dsh-model-sync README · ✨ Key Features：* 🏷️ **Smart Collections & Catalog Auto-Tagging**: Automatically categorizes models into standardized tags (`coding`, `reasoning`, `fast`, `vision`, `long-context`) during discovery, provides fast pill-button filtering in the Web UI, and introduces a one-click "⭐ Curated Best" selection preset for top flagship models.
* ⚡ **Latency TTFT Radar & Sparklines**: Probes response latency and Time To First Token (TTFT) across models, renders ASCII sparklines (` ▂▃▂ `) and 4-tier speed badges (⚡ `< 300ms`, 🟢 `< 1.2s`, 🟡 `1.5 - 3.0s`, 🔴 `> 3.0s`), and exposes `GET /dsh-model-sync/health/latency` for intelligent downstream routing.
* 💸 **Dynamic Live Pricing Sync & Prompt Caching**: Periodic background updates of live model pricing from OpenRouter and LiteLLM snapshots with persistent disk fallback cache, tracking prompt cache read/write costs (`cacheReadPerToken`, `cacheWritePerToken`), with `GET /dsh-model-sync/pricing` and `POST /dsh-model-sync/pricing/sync` endpoints.

@goodandready/dsh-model-sync README · ⚙️ Configuration (`settings.yaml`)：| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Master switch for background synchronization |
| `scheduleEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable periodic background synchronization schedule |
| `intervalMinutes` | `number` | `60` | Polling frequency for catalog refreshes in minutes |
| `autoApply` | `boolean` | `false` | Automatically apply discovered models to active catalog |
| `requestTimeoutMs`| `number` | `15000` | HTTP request timeout for catalog fetching (ms) |
| `retryAttempts` | `number` | `3` | Maximum retry attempts for transient network failures |
| `concurrency` | `number` | `4` | Maximum parallel provider synchronization workers |
| `providers` | `array` | `[]` | Per-provider configuration list (`provider`, `enabled`, `autoApply`) |

@goodandready/dsh-model-sync README · 🔍 Active Capability Probing & Verification：- **Micro-Probes**: Accurately test actual model capabilities rather than relying on declared flags:
  - `JSON Schema`: Tests structured output generation (`response_format: { type: "json_schema" }`).
  - `Tools / Functions`: Tests function call generation and parameter handling.
  - `Vision`: Tests multimodal processing with lightweight image payloads.
  - `Developer Role`: Validates `developer` role prompt acceptance for advanced reasoning models.
- **UI Actions**: One-click "🔍 Verify Capabilities" on any provider card, plus global "🔍 Verify All Models" and "⚡ Verify New Only" buttons in catalog toolbar.
- **Verified Badges**: Highlights confirmed features with green indicators (`✔ Tools`, `✔ Vision`, `✔ JSON`, `✔ DevRole`) persisted across restarts.

@goodandready/dsh-model-sync README · 🦙 Ollama & Local Engine Hub：- **Direct Web Management**: Pull, monitor, and manage local Ollama models directly from DSH Web UI without SSH.
- **Streaming Pull Progress**: Real-time layer download progress bar with speed and transferred byte metrics.
- **GPU VRAM Management**: Displays active models in VRAM (`/api/ps`) and provides instant "⏏ Unload from VRAM" (`keep_alive: 0`) to free GPU resources.
- **Architecture & Quantization**: Displays quantization levels (`Q4_K_M`, `Q8_0`), family, context windows, and offers direct deletion.
